question:
Who of the following was receiver of Bharat Ratna award?

I. Lata Mangeshkar

II. Bhupen Hazarika
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar** was awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honor, in 2001.
 
• **Bhupen Hazarika** received the Bharat Ratna posthumously in 2019.
 
• The Bharat Ratna is conferred in recognition of exceptional service/performance of the highest order in any field of human endeavor.
 
• It is the highest civilian award in India, instituted on 2 January 1954.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharat Ratna**

 
 
• The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award in India, given for exceptional service in any field.
 
• It was instituted on 2 January 1954 by the President of India.
 
• The award consists of a Sanad (certificate) signed by the President and a medallion.
 
• There is no formal provision that the award should be given to Indian citizens only. It has been awarded to a naturalized citizen (Mother Teresa) and to two non-Indians (Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan and Nelson Mandela).
 
 
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar**
 
 
• Renowned playback singer, known as the "Nightingale of India".
 
• She has sung songs in over thirty-six regional Indian languages and foreign languages.
 
• She was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2001, recognizing her contributions to the Indian music industry.
 
 
 
• **Bhupen Hazarika**
 
 
• An Indian playback singer, lyricist, musician, poet, and film-maker from Assam.
 
• He is known for his works in Assamese, Bengali, and Hindi cinema.
 
• He was posthumously awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2019.
